llmJudgeRequirements.reason: preferencesAtom is created with atomWithStorage using createJSONStorage(() => AsyncStorage) as the third argument.
evidence: const preferencesAtom = atomWithStorage<Preferences>(STORAGE_KEY, SAFE_DEFAULT_PREFERENCES, createJSONStorage(() => AsyncStorage))

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Hydration completion is tracked in dedicated atom state
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: A dedicated boolean atom `preferencesHydratedAtom` tracks hydration completion and is set to true in the finally block of hydratePreferencesAtom.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Preference-dependent content is gated behind a deterministic pre-hydration UI branch
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The component returns an early loading UI branch when !preferencesHydrated, preventing preference-dependent content from rendering before hydration.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Hydration action runs first and profile loading is triggered only after hydration completes
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: hydratePreferences runs in the first useEffect unconditionally; the profile-loading useEffect guards on `if (!preferencesHydrated) return`, so profile fetch only starts after hydration sets preferencesHydratedAtom to true.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Post-hydration profile load fetches the users endpoint and builds preview text from `firstName` and `lastName`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Fetches 'https://dummyjson.com/users/1' and builds preview text as `${profile.firstName} ${profile.lastName}` from the typed ProfilePreviewResponse.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Preference toggle actions update persisted state through functional atom updater paths
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Both toggleTheme and toggleCompact call setPreferences with a functional updater (previous) => ({...}), deriving next state from previous state.
